usedFor: Insighto.ai keeps contacts and data sources, and “New Contact” starts a template whenever a contact is created.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Contact” in Insighto.ai
bestTemplate.why: A new booking adds the person as a contact, so they are already known when they get in touch.

watchOut: “New Contact” in Insighto.ai is polling, so a template runs after a scheduled check.
